parsed.rationale: Both participating records live inside test targets: one in `Shared/Metadata/Tests/MetadataTests/DiscogsMarkupParserTests.swift` (package `Metadata`) and the other in `WXYC/iOS/Tests/WXYCTests/DiscogsFormatterTests.swift` (package `app:iOS`). Although the context flags do not set `is_test: true`, the file paths unambiguously place both declarations inside `Tests/` directories, making them test fixtures. Each test file defines its own local `MockDiscogsEntityResolver.MockError` type-alias-union scoped to its own mock resolver, which is the canonical pattern for isolated test doubles. Consolidating them would couple two independent test suites and risk leaking test-only types into shared production targets.
